question: Who has won the prestigious ‘Eni Award,’ which is considered among the top global honours for scientific research in energy and environment in July 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thalappil Pradeep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Thalappil Pradeep is a renowned Indian scientist known for his groundbreaking work in the field of nanotechnology and materials science.
 
• He has made significant contributions to the development of affordable clean water technologies, which have been recognized globally.
 
• The Eni Award is one of the most prestigious international awards for scientific research in energy and the environment, highlighting Pradeep's exceptional achievements.
 
• His innovative work includes the creation of nanomaterials that can remove contaminants from water, providing clean drinking water solutions to millions of people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eni Award**

 
 
• The Eni Award is an annual international award established by the Italian energy company Eni in 2007.
 
• It is often referred to as the "Nobel Prize for Energy" and aims to promote better use of energy sources and increased environmental research.
 
• The award recognizes outstanding research and technological innovation in the fields of energy efficiency, renewable energy, and environmental protection.
 
• Winners receive a gold medal specially minted by the Italian State Mint and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Nanotechnology**
 
 
• Nanotechnology involves the manipulation of matter on an atomic, molecular, and supramolecular scale.
 
• Applications of nanotechnology are vast and include medicine, electronics, biomaterials, and energy production.
 
• Thalappil Pradeep's work primarily focuses on using nanotechnology to develop sustainable and cost-effective solutions for water purification.
 
 
 
• **Water Purification Technologies**
 
 
• Water purification technologies are essential for providing clean drinking water and ensuring public health.
 
• These technologies include physical processes such as filtration, sedimentation, and distillation, as well as chemical processes like chlorination and the use of advanced materials.
 
• Thalappil Pradeep has developed novel nanomaterials that can effectively remove contaminants such as heavy metals and pathogens from water, making it safe for consumption.
